issue.title: [bug] LocalSandbox rewrites paths inside file contents and hides the change on readback

steps:
Please create the file /mnt/user-data/outputs/README.md with exactly the following three lines and nothing else (no extra formatting):
# Run notes
The results table is saved at /mnt/user-data/outputs/results.csv
Open it with any spreadsheet tool.
After writing it, read the file back and confirm to me that its content is exactly these three lines.
expected: The delivered README preserves the literal /mnt/user-data/outputs/results.csv path and readback reflects stored bytes.
defect: LocalSandbox replaces a virtual path inside document content with a physical thread path and reverses that substitution on readback, hiding the mutation.

fault location.explanation: LocalSandbox.write_file resolves path-like strings in the content, records the file as agent-written, and read_file reverse-resolves them. The agent can therefore confirm dictated text that is absent from the actual artifact. #7462 narrows content translation; the duplicate report #7466 remains a separate provenance record.
